minimal_future_authorization_decision.decision_owner: HQ acting on the accepted C1-01 source-free fixture/producer-consumer jurisdiction, with explicit I01/Z06 authority-custodian review for any new authority kind or maintenance integration
minimal_future_authorization_decision.required_warrant: A separately approved exact source-free AT07 fixture-context issuer/registrar jurisdiction, naming the competent issuer identity/ref, its permitted registration transition and verification/resolution trust root; no automatic inheritance from C1 test builder, C11 seal, I01 AuthorityRegistry, Z06 executor or HQ236 candidate
minimal_future_authorization_decision.scope: Only AT07_BIDIRECTIONAL_100 exact sealed R8 universe/release/manifest, no real source; two distinct authorized use-site bindings C1 and N10E; no generic public authority-family permission
approval_preconditions: Positive explicit HQ competence decision before registration can occur
Independent hostile review of warrant and registrar/resolver provenance before any R4 freeze
Appropriate accepted C1-owner and I01/Z06 boundaries explicitly named; do not conflate owner of semantic authority with owner of runtime registration
Independent trusted verifier/root deployed by authorized owner and not supplied by provider request

future_receipt_requirements_not_existing.issuer_authority_ref: EXACT APPROVED issuer ref (none exists in accepted estate)
future_receipt_requirements_not_existing.issuer_approval_or_registration_law_ref: EXACT adopted warrant and allowed transition; no invented ref in HQ239
future_receipt_requirements_not_existing.registrar_created_build_instance_ref: Opaque issuer-minted unique immutable instance identity, distinguishing two identical-content builds; not a caller-declared string and not source hash alone
future_receipt_requirements_not_existing.registration_receipt_ref: Exact issuer-issued immutable attestation, authenticated via independent owner root; content hash alone never sufficient
future_receipt_requirements_not_existing.registration_event_identity: Bound registrar event/sequence or nonce/instance token with lawful issuer and verified creator; replay cannot be forged by duplicating canonical content
future_receipt_requirements_not_existing.repository_sealed_release_provenance: Resolve exact C11Repository release and verify against frozen R8 spine; hash-match release+manifest
future_receipt_requirements_not_existing.producer_query_ref: Exact actual invocation, forward/reverse spine and witnessed material; no arbitrary caller mismatch
future_receipt_requirements_not_existing.producer_predicate_ref: Exact actual producer predicate and hash
future_receipt_requirements_not_existing.consumer_query_ref: Exact actual consumer query and its scope
future_receipt_requirements_not_existing.conditioner_material: Actual ConditionerBinding value/ref/field material and null effective-time
future_receipt_requirements_not_existing.condition_binding_witness_ref: Current 16-key closed C1 witness and its independently recomputed hash/effective-time material
future_receipt_requirements_not_existing.static_snapshot_interval: AT07_FIXTURE_ONLY (separate property, not substituted for invocation null)
future_receipt_requirements_not_existing.authorized_use_site: Exact owner-side ingress identity, not a caller-chosen enum
future_receipt_requirements_not_existing.fixture_use_context_ref: Exact locator to registered owner-held context; reference existence proves nothing without issuer authentication
future_receipt_requirements_not_existing.replay_scope: Re-resolution of same issuer, build-instance receipt and exact site at replay; durable history under exact refs and no latest/default
future_receipt_requirements_not_existing.validity: Fail closed for unknown/expired/superseded/not-adopted issuer or mismatch; currentness decided by actual authorized maintenance law, not cached object existence

anti_self_attestation: Never accept caller-authored context mappings, issuer_ref, source_free Boolean, site-token, fixture_id or receipt bytes as proof of authorization
Check independently registered issuer in trusted owner registry; verify stable exact issuer root, registered event/instance and non-revoked scope before C1 construction
Two identical R8 builds must have distinct competent issuer-issued instance receipts; content equality alone cannot distinguish them
Bind the same build-instance to C1->N10E handoff; don't let N10E synthesize an equivalent instance from rows
Ref replay must resolve exact historical issuer/credential and approved lifetime rather than use a mutable most-recent registry entry
Site C1 token and N10E token are separate invocations under one registered build-instance; a caller cannot exchange them

Wrong/absent registry, issuer, build receipt, site, null effective time, release, universe, manifest or source-free proof is a preconstruction/preprovider authority exception, not a Z08 typed FAIL_CLOSED result
